initiatives.name: Black Lives Matter Cleveland
initiatives.description: Cleveland chapter formed in December 2015 after the killing of Tamir Rice. Runs a mutual aid fund for families affected by police and gun violence and organizes direct actions.

initiatives.name: LGBT Community Center of Greater Cleveland
initiatives.description: LGBTQ+ community center at 6600 Detroit Ave in Cleveland running support groups, youth and 50+ programs, events, and the annual Pride in the CLE.

initiatives.name: The Rhizome House
initiatives.description: Radical social center and infoshop at 2174 Lee Road, Cleveland Heights. Hosts reading groups, workshops and community cleanups, and runs a lending library. Open Sundays 1-4pm.

initiatives.name:
Burning River Anarchist
              Collective
initiatives.description: Cleveland anarchist collective founded in 2000. Runs a not-for-profit book distro and publisher and a lending library of over 2,600 titles.

initiatives.name: Cleveland Pandemic Response
initiatives.description: A group of neighborhood organizers and community members aiming to provide mutual aid and support to NEO residents during the COVID-19 pandemic.

initiatives.name: Food Not Bombs Lake County and East Side CLE
initiatives.description: We share free fresh fruits and vegetables twice a month in Willoughby, and twice a month on Cleveland’s east side.

initiatives.name: Westside Cleveland Food Not Bombs
initiatives.description: FNB is a national movement that opposes militarism and provides free food for the public, no questions asked.

initiatives.name:
The InterReligious Task Force on Central America
              (IRTF)
initiatives.description: IRTF is a Cleveland-based interfaith group that promotes solidarity, human rights, and collective liberation.

initiatives.name: Cleveland Liberation Center
initiatives.description: Socialist community space at 9801 Denison Ave in Cleveland, run by PSL Cleveland, hosting forums, film screenings, open mics, and organizing meetings.

initiatives.name: The People's Distro
initiatives.description: Worker-run group in Cleveland that gives out free fresh produce, clothes, and other goods in neighborhoods, with no one turned away.

initiatives.name: Party for Socialism and Liberation - Cleveland
initiatives.description: Cleveland branch of the Party for Socialism and Liberation, a socialist party. Holds public forums and protests and runs political education in Cleveland.

initiatives.name: JVP Cleveland
initiatives.description: Cleveland chapter of Jewish Voice for Peace, organizing Jews in solidarity with Palestinian freedom through protests and advocacy.
